description: Kenya - Energy Spending per Sector in Nairobi is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand", published or maintained by World Bank / Camco Clean Energy (World Bank Group). Data extracted from World Bank TRACE Report Nairobi 2014. Data are for year 2013. Citation: Negawatt challenge. A curated list of datasets for the World Bank Negawatt Challenge competition in Accra and Nairobi cities. Coverage: Nairobi. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy demand. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
